golden parity traces reproduce from the shipped ONNX with max |delta| 0.0
motion CSVs parse under the runner's own ReadMetadata/ReadCSV/ReadCSV3D rules

tensorrt.why: docs/source/getting_started/installation_deploy.md marks any other version as producing incorrect inference and dangerous robot behavior
tensorrt.closure_note: libnvinfer-safe-headers-dev is excluded: it exists only at >=10.16 and nothing under runner/src includes NvInferSafe*

deployment_rehearsal.robot_stand_in: sim/run_robot_sim.py -- MuJoCo on the DDS bus, rt/lowstate + rt/lowcmd, unmodified runner
deployment_rehearsal.cyclonedds: 0.10.2, built against the copy vendored in runner/thirdparty/unitree_sdk2
deployment_rehearsal.default_motion: walk_arc_cw_stop_001__A047 (the clip the measured results describe)

measured_run.fixed_stand: 0.759 -> 0.772 m, held 5.5 s under kp 99 kd 6

value_level_parity.outlier: 1 tick of 499; all 29 joints together, neighbours clean at ~2e-06, offset equals one control tick of joint motion -- the runner dumps obs_buffer_ after Infer() has already consumed it, so the log can catch one input update later than the inference did. Log artefact.

comparison_at_10_16.note: systematic across every tick; 76x worse mean. The version pin is visible in the numbers.

measured_stand.note: simulation only; the vendor sim config ships ENABLE_ELASTIC_BAND: True

start_pose_step.finding: All three shipped clips begin far from default_angles, the pose the runner holds before ']'. The policy must close that gap in one control step, standing.
start_pose_step.consequence: evaluate.sh resets the robot ONTO the reference and reports 0/16 falls at lambda 0; drill.sh starts it in the runner's standing pose and it goes down within seconds. The drill is the one that resembles deployment.

hardware_runs.artifacts: none -- run.sh wrote no files at the time; see commit 17491f9

historical_measurement_scope: Existing top-level measurements describe the legacy iteration-8000 three-motion pair. Latest four-motion iteration-4000 results are in latest_policy_set.

lafan_rank9_release.status: experimental; upright in all four full-clip simulations, path threshold exceeded in all four; not hardware validated
